_readme: Copy to env/dev.json and env/prod.json (git-ignored), fill real values. Client IDs come from the Arul Google Cloud project (arul-prod-db4f8, project number 1083884444243) — never reuse Pakiza's.
_google_android_client_id: Record only — google_sign_in never reads it; Google matches the Android client by package + SIGNING SHA-1 at request time. Three are registered for com.hsrutility.arul (debug C8:30:3E:87, upload 9D:F7:52:5F, Play App Signing 5D:D1:97:AD). prod.json must name the PLAY one: Play re-signs the upload, so that is the only client real users authorize through, and it is the id Google's OAuth quota form asks for. Read the mapping out of android/app/google-services.json, never off a console field you believe you copied.
_firebase: "true" is the norm — env/dev.json and env/prod.json both set it, and every real build ships Crashlytics + Performance + GA4. It is "false" here only because android/app/google-services.json is git-ignored: a fresh clone must add its own file first, then flip this to "true". Enabling it without the file makes Firebase.initializeApp() fail.
